decisions.reason: The yogurt sits close to the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how, and its award gives management a clear signal it can read and build on.
This flagship flavored cheese builds on the firm's established cheese competence, which lets it interpret early sales and refine the recipe.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing production knowledge and organic milk supply, so the risk of keeping it is low.
The spicy cheese line uses existing cheese know-how, but its several variants may be trimmed, so dropping the line as a whole is unlikely.
The mild soft cheese extends the firm's dairy competence into a new product family it can still learn to manage, and it rounds out the new range.
Washed-rind soft cheese is technically more distant from the firm's core and its results are harder to read, but it fits the new cheese range and gets another year.
